cohort: The study included a matched cohort of 100 women who received care from the same Midwifery Group Practice (MGP) midwives, comparing those who gave birth at home with those who gave birth in hospital.
finding: The study found improved outcomes for women choosing to birth at home, demonstrating that the place of birth makes a difference.
mod_finding: Women who gave birth at home were more likely to have a normal birth and less likely to have assisted births or caesarean sections compared to the matched cohort who birthed in hospital.
